title: Transformation 与 Action 分类与计数
expected_output:
Transformation 惰性, 返回新 RDD:
  - map
  - filter
  - flatMap
  - groupByKey
  - reduceByKey
  - join
  - union
  - distinct
  - sortBy
  - persist
Action 触发计算:
  - collect
  - count
  - take
  - saveAsTextFile
  - reduce
  - foreach
  - first
Transformation 数 = 10, Action 数 = 7
判别法则: 返回值是否为 RDD -> 是则 transformation, 否则 action
code:
transformations = ["map", "filter", "flatMap", "groupByKey", "reduceByKey", "join", "union", "distinct", "sortBy", "persist"]
actions = ["collect", "count", "take", "saveAsTextFile", "reduce", "foreach", "first"]
print("Transformation 惰性, 返回新 RDD:")
for t in transformations:
    print("  -", t)
print("Action 触发计算:")
for a in actions:
    print("  -", a)
print(f"Transformation 数 = {len(transformations)}, Action 数 = {len(actions)}")
print("判别法则: 返回值是否为 RDD -> 是则 transformation, 否则 action")
